text:
maria: Quick q — we're debugging a customer perf regression and I can't find the canonical GPU inference dashboard. Need panels for SM% (per-GPU), GPU memory (GB + %), KV cache hitrate, avg batch size, and recent tail latency. Who has the link or dashboard id? Also want to tune the KV eviction alert to be less noisy but catch regressions earlier.

raj: Try the cluster dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/8f3a1c/gpu-inference-overview — panels 3 (SM%), 7 (GPU mem), 12 (KV hitrate), 14 (avg batch size), 21 (p99 latency). Bookmarking that one is helpful.

maria: Thanks — do you have the PromQL snippets for the KV hitrate + SM% so I can add a small ad-hoc panel in my notebook?

raj: Yep, basic ones below (our metric names are a little messy, but these are what dashboards use):

```
# SM% (per GPU)
avg by (gpu) (100 * nv_gpu_sm_active_cycles_total / nv_gpu_sm_total_cycles)

# KV cache hitrate (5m window)
sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_lookups_total[5m]))

# avg batch size (requests)
sum(rate(inf_request_batch_size_sum[1m])) / sum(rate(inf_request_batch_size_count[1m]))
```

jen: Small note — histograms for latency are on the latency dashboard (different) but the p99 panel Raj pointed at is a single-query rollup we keep for quick triage.

oliver: For KV evictions we also have an eviction rate metric: `kvcache_evictions_total`. We get a lot of flapping alerts currently because the alert uses a 1m window and fires on short spikes. Suggest changing to 5m sustained >2% of lookups or absolute evictions > 50/min for a node.

maria: That sounds reasonable. Can you draft the alert rule example? I'll open the PR.

oliver: Sure — example alert rule (prometheus-style) below:

```
- alert: KVCACHE_EvictionSpikes
  expr: (sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_lookups_total[5m]))) > 0.02
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache eviction rate > 2% sustained (5m)"
    runbook: "See runbook: docs/runbooks/observability/kvcache-evictions"
```

jen: +1 to the threshold, and add a second predicate for absolute rate to avoid noisy low-traffic hosts: `sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (instance) > 50` as a separate alert.

maria: I'll open a small PR to update the alerting rules and the dashboard link in the incident runbook. Assigning to @jen for review.

deploy-bot: Created alert-rules PR: #7263 by maria — CI checks running.

raj: FYI — when you change the alert, also update the grafana panel's transparency note (panel 12) so on-call knows this is tuned.

maria: Good call. I'll add a short note in the panel description. Thanks everyone. If anything spikes after the change, ping `#eng-oncall` and tag me. :thumbsup:
